message: A building must now be finished before another can be started: the app shows how many registered meters are still outstanding and lists them. A meter cannot be captured twice in a month (once for electricity and once for water where both exist). Every reading is shown for confirmation before it is saved, and can be changed until it has been submitted. Version 1.0.2 uses an older signing key and cannot install this update in place; contact the administrator before uninstalling.
